title: Proofs of Prophethood 24: Jews of Hijaz
normalized_text: As-salamu-alaykum-wa-rahmatullahi-wa-barakatuh. Welcome to another video in the proofs of Prophet series. Let's get straight to it. We find in the Quran the following verses. They will not harm you except for some annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs. Then they will not be aided. Al-Qadi Abd al-Jabbar and exegesis of the Quran identify this as a very clear prophecy that came to pass. The Muslims that were in Medina at the time were surrounded by the Jewish tribes Bani Qaynuqa, Bani Nadir, and Bani Qurayza. And not too far away, you even had the Jews of Khaybar. Now, the verse doesn't simply predict that the Muslims will be victorious against them, but it goes as far to say that they will not be harmed in any meaningful way. Not only that, keep in mind that the Jews there at the time were very well equipped and were actually quite dangerous. Al-Qadi Abd al-Jabbar also points out that revealing these verses publicly doesn't really fit in with actions of man. If a king feels negatively towards some tribes that are living on his land, the last thing that he would want to do is reveal the animosity that he feels towards them because that would simply bring hostility towards him. Furthermore, how could he be certain that they would not be receiving harm from the Jews? One could only make a prediction like this if they had complete certainty. And in this case, that certainty came in the form of revelation. And that's all I have for you guys today. I'll see you guys in the next one, inshallah. As-salamu-alaykum-wa-rahmatullahi-wa-barakatuh.
